insufficient_correspondences: BLOCKED measurement; never substitute zero residual

measurement.channel: native Y; no mutation of native planes
measurement.complementary: mutual information 32bins; descriptive, not gate threshold
measurement.local: masked NCC, quadratic subpixel peak; bidirectional agreement
measurement.mask: 64px measurement rim; ESM3/6 chroma abs(U-128)>12 or abs(V-128)>12, dilated3px; transient metric exclusion, no object detection

orientation: native pixel parity distinct from unverified gravity, thermal gradient and growth directions; no inference from condition names
roi: largest all-valid axis-aligned rectangle per condition, all15 native supports transformed; report any unverified padding/overlay exclusions separately
scale: UNRESOLVED and pixels without sufficient primary evidence
selection: first model passing pooled estimation and every estimation frame; frozen matrices before reading validation pixels; no refit after validation
